'''|BA| - Bored Again''' is a {{Flag/eu}} [[4on4]] clan created in [[2025]] by [[Mille]] and [[Sailorman]]. The team was created with the goal of becoming the most active team in the scene in order to close the gap on the competition. The project was short-lived, however, and was discontinued when [[Mille]]'s brothers [[Mythic]] and [[Edvin]] came back to Quakeworld, leading to the revival of [[Ving]].
